subject.title: Render sessions without opaque routing keys

question: Should the first implementation include both contract-driven titles and a new background-session view, or should the visibility UX be split into a follow-up after the parser and presentation projection land?
rationale: Structured titles are a bounded compatibility fix, while deciding which execution categories disappear by default and how users reveal them establishes a broader navigation policy.

options.title: Split presentation and visibility
options.body: Land structured parsing, safe titles, and agent grouping first, then implement the explicit background-session view in a separately reviewed UX change.

options.title: Deliver one complete navigation change
options.body: Implement presentation, grouping, default filtering, and the background-session view together with current-head WinUI proof for the full workflow.

recommendation.title: Split presentation and visibility
recommendation.body: Land structured parsing, safe titles, and agent grouping first, then implement the explicit background-session view in a separately reviewed UX change.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the detailed contract and UX proposal and are best positioned to confirm whether the visibility work is one product change or a follow-up.
